objective.name: sandbox.py.echo
objective.description: Interpreted wrapper-backed echo capacity for Execution N6 tests

#root.role: Return an echoed message through the interpreted wrapper runtime.

effects.wrapper_runtime: The interpreted wrapper runtime may be started lazily.

transformation_contract.morphing: An echoed message request becomes a wrapper-produced echo through the interpreted execution path.
invariants: sandbox.py.echo must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.py.echo returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.py.echo fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
